name: wabaileys-bridge
description: WhatsApp Baileys bridge — REST API for eCan.ai channel integration

scripts.build:win: npm run prebuild && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-win-x64   --compress GZip --public --output dist/wa_bridge.exe
scripts.build:mac-x64: npm run prebuild && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-macos-x64 --compress GZip --public --output dist/wa_bridge_mac_x64
scripts.build:mac-arm64: npm run prebuild && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-macos-arm64 --compress GZip --public --output dist/wa_bridge_mac_arm64
scripts.build:linux: npm run prebuild && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-linux-x64 --compress GZip --public --output dist/wa_bridge_linux
